title.zh: 修改集群组件实例配置

descriptions.zh:
使用该API可修改普通集群组件的配置以及ACK Pro集群的管控面参数配置：
- 普通组件可配置参数列表可通过DescribeClusterAddonMetadata
API 查询，详情参见[查询集群组件版本元数据](~~2667944~~)。
- ACK Pro集群管控面组件可配置的参数列表，请参见[自定义ACK Pro集群的管控面参数](~~199588~~)。

修改配置可能会导致组件重新部署和启动，请评估影响后再进行操作。
descriptions.en:
You can call this API operation to modify the configuration of common clusters components and the control plane parameter settings of ACK Pro clusters:
- To query the configurable parameters of common components, call the DescribeClusterAddonMetadata API operation. For details, see [Query cluster component version metadata](~~2667944~~).
- For the configurable control plane parameter settings of ACK Pro clusters, see [Customize control plane parameters of ACK Pro clusters](~~199588~~).

Modifying configurations may cause the component to be redeployed and restarted. Evaluate the impact before performing this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cs modify-cluster-addon --cluster-id c71d616e629ff40d5b42d7bb877700000 --component-id coredns --config CpuRequest_:_800m --region cn-hangzhou
